Commentary.Commentary: Now then, in the last two games, South Africa managed to defend such totals but now we have to see can the Windies do so? An exciting second half awaits.

The bowling was good for most of the parts but Bavuma will be disappointed with how it ended. THey did well in the Powerplay, Linde and Shamsi were exceptional in the middle overs. However, Rabada and Ngidi leaked a lot of runs towards the end which could well coist South Africa the game.

The Windies though started brilliantly after being inserted! Lewis and Simmons got them off to a flier, Lewis fell but Simmons continued. However, once the Powerplay ended and the spinners came on, the flow of runs stopped and also wickets fell. At one stage, 150 looked difficult but a half ton by the skipper has taken them close to 170.

Yet again a total around 170 but how have the Windies got to that total? They were down and out during the 15th over when they lost Russell and were 101 for 6. However, then began the fightback courtesy Pollard, their skipper. He began slowly but then towards the end showed his might and he along with Allen smashed 66 from the last 4 overs to take the Windies to a total which is surely defendable.
A dot to end but the damage was done in the previous 11 balls! 18 from the last over. A yorker on middle, it is jammed out towards the bowler. WINDIES END WITH 167!

SIX! Smacked! 50 up in style and that is a special innings from the Windies skipper. His team were in trouble and he delivers. This is short and on middle, asking to be hit. Comes at a nice height. He waits back and hammers it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Just the one! On middle, this is hit down to long on for one. Pollard now on strike.
FOUR! Raining boundaries now all of a sudden! Short and outside off, this is slapped over covers for another boundary!
Swing and a miss! A rare dot now! Outside off, a slower one. Allen swings but misses.
WIDE! Now an extra! This is wide outside off, Allen lets it be. De Kock fails to collect it cleanly but no run taken.
SIX! Now Allen joins the party! That is right in the slot! Full and on middle, it is smashed over the long on fence for a biggie. 150 up for the Windies. Still 5 balls to go. 170 possible.

FOUR! Finds the gap again! 25 runs from the 19th and the Windies are now well in reach of 160. Another full toss by Rabada, this is played wide of the fielder at mid-wicket. He runs there, dives and tries ot push it back in but fails to do so.
Outside off, fuller, Allen carves it over point for one.

PUT DOWN AGAIN! Miller again! This time it is Pollard! This could prove really very costyl! It is a low full toss on off, Pollard mistimes it down to long off. Miller runs and looks to take it but spills it. That was an easy chance. A single taken.
WIDE! Pressure getting to Rabada! Well wide outside off, left alone.
SIX! Three in a row and all of a sudden the scoreboard looks good for the Windies! He goes short and Pollard was probably waiting for it. He pulls it well over the square leg fence for a biggie.
SIX! Over the fence yet again! Back-to-back biggies to begin the penultimate over! This is yet another full toss on off, it is hammered over the mid-wicket fence for a big one.
SIX! Over the fence! This is a full toss on the pads, another gift for Pollard! This is whipped over the fine leg fence for a biggie. Perfect start to the over.
Rabada is back on!
A single to end a good over for the Windies! A full toss on the pads, this is whipped through square leg for one.
A low full toss on off, it is hit towards cover for one.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Through the hands of Miller! Shorter and on middle, Allen flat-bats it down the ground. He does not time it that well. Miller runs to his left and looks to take a tumbling catch but spills it and it goes to the fence behind.
A dot! Gold dust! Short and outside off, it is the cutter so it cuts back in. Allen slashes but misses.
A full toss on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one. 6 from the first two balls.

EDGY FOUR! Windies won't mind how they come as long as they do! This is short and wide outside off, Pollard slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge past the keeper and down to the third man fence.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. It is left alone!

A single to end! Another full toss, this one is a slower one, dipping on the batter, it is played towards deep mid-wicket for one. Nortje did really well to complete that over. Also, a good day for him, 4-0-32-1 for him.
SIX! Over the fence and it is a welcome biggie! A full toss, a gift and Pollard takes it, he heaves it over the mid-wicket fence fror a biggie.
A low full toss, not easy to hit, it is hit down to long on for one. Nortje is limping as he makes his way back to his mark.
A yorker on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
A yorker on off, it is jammed out to covers for one.
The physio is out! Nortje is in serious pain. The good news is he is back onto his feet and walking nicely. This guy is tough. Even better news, Nortje is going to keep going.

OUCH! That is not good, that is really not good! Nortje is in a lot of pain! This is full and on off, Pollard hammers it back towards the bowler, Nortje looks to move out of the way but fails to do so and it hits him on his knee. The batters take one as it goes down to long off.
This one turns back in nicely! It lands outside off and then spins into the batter! Allen stays back and then pushes it to covers. End of another magical spell from Shamsi.
Another dot! On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
The googly on middle, Allen hangs back and blocks it.

OUT! CAUGHT! Some more spinner magic for the proteas and Shamsi gets his second wicket! A loopy delivery, on middle. Drags his length down a bit. Russell reaches to the pitch of the ball and looks to paddle it, but gets a thick outside edge, straight to Anrich Nortje at short fine leg. The big Russ departs just for 9 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Anrich Nortje b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: A bye! This lands around leg, Pollard then makes room and looks to play the slog sweep. He misses as the ball turns back in. Hits the outer part of the glove of de Kock towards short fine leg for one.
100 up for the windies! Loopy ball, on the pads, flicked to fine leg for a single.
Single to end the over! Fuller ball, outside off. Russell slashes it to extra cover.
Length ball, outside off. Pollard steps down and pushes it to long off for another single.
A short ball, outside off, pulled to long on for another single.
On middle, worked to long on for one.
Good delivery! Bowls a fiery wide yorker. Pollard misses to get his bat on the ball completely.
Full toss, outside off. Russell drives it to covers for a single.
Again paddle sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Off the mark, Andre Russell! Tossed up, on middle. Russell slogs it in the gap, between mid-wicket and long on for a boundary.
On middle. Blocked it out.
Russell walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! Spinners doing the magic for the saffas! And West Indies finds them 5 down! Another loopy ball, around leg. Pooran gets on knee and slogs it, doesn't middle it, in the air and straight in the hands of Rassie van der Dussen at deep square leg. Nicholas Pooran departs for 16 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off. Kept out.
WIDE! Loopy ball, on middle, pitches and spins away over the tramline. Wide called.
LEG BYE! Flatter, on the pads. Pollard misses his flick, the ball rlls to the leg side off the pads and a leg bye is taken.
Single to end the over as this is worked to mid-wicket. Excellent spell comes to end from George Linde
Slower ball, on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off, pushed to point.
Darted on the pads, nudges it to the on side for a single.
Pitches it up, around leg. Pooran paddles it to short fine leg for a run.
FOUR! In the gap! Fractionally short, on middle. Pooran rocks back and pulls it wide of square leg for a boundary.
Outside off, pushed to mid off for a quick single. 8 runs coming off this over.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Angles this on a short ball, on middle. Pooran helps it along towards the fine leg fence for four.
Length ball, on off. Pollard pushes it to mid off and runs across for one run.
Comes 'round the wicket, bowls a length ball, on the pads, flicked to square leg for another single.
A full toss, on middle, this is driven to long on for a single.
A good length delivery, outside off. Left alone to the keeper.
Pollard is off the mark as this is eased down to long on for a single.
Kieron Pollard walks out to bat! The skipper has a huge role to play! His side is in trouble and he needs to fire.

OUT! LBW! That looked plumb straightaway and Simmons doesn't even wait to review it. Spinners again doing the job for the visitors! A loopy ball, around off. Lendl Simmons gets on his knee and looks to paddle but the ball sneaks through and he gets hit on the front pad. The Proteas appeal and the umpire raises his finger straightaway. Lendl Simmons goes back in the hut for 47. Windies in deep trouble.
Pitches it up, on middle. Pooran paddles it to square leg for another single.
Again on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for another single.
Tossed up, on middle. Pooran shuffles and clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Floated ball, outside off. Pooran looks to cut but misses.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.

Impact was outside off! This lands around off and then spins away! Pooran looks to sweep but misses. It hits him on the pads. An appeal but the umpire turns it down. De Kock really liked it but they do not review.
Another shortish ball on middle, it is worked through square leg for one.
Pooran is off the mark! Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Simmons is struggling even to score a single right now! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Nicholas Pooran walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The pressure was building and the windies couldn't play the proteas spinners once again! A loopy ball, way outside off. Shimron Hetmyer goes for a full blooded slash, but gets a thick outside edge, into the keeper's mitt, who grabs the ball without much time.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b George Linde

Commentary.Commentary: Tap and run! Loopy ball, outside off. Simmons taps to point and runs for a quick single.
Flatter, quicker, around leg. Simmons misses his heave.
Another outside off delivery. Simmons cut but finds the fielder at point.
Outside off, chops it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fractionally short, on middle. Simmons rock back and eases it down to long on for one.
A run out appeal has been taken upstairs!

NOT OUT! Hetmyer is well in! A low full toss on middle, it is pushed to the left of Shamsi who gets to the ball quickly. Hetmyer takes a start and then goes back. Shamsi fires it to the keeper who underarms it onto the stumps. An appeal, it is taken upstairs but replays show that Hetmyer is in.
On middle, kept out.
BEAUTY! That is unplayable! This lands on off and the spins away. Hetmyer is beaten as he tries to flick. De Kock does not collect cleanly. Could have been a stumping chance.
On middle, kept out.
On middle, this is worked on the leg side for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
On middle, Simmons pushes it back to the bowler. End of a brilliant first over by Linde. Just the one from it.
Simmons misses out and he is disgusted with himself! This is very short and very wide. Simmons cuts but to point.
Close! Pressure building on Simmons now! This is fired full and on the pads, Simmons swings but misses.
Make that 5! Shorter and outside off again, it is played to point again.
4 dots in a row for Simmons! On off, this is guided to point.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.

Another dot to end the Powerplay! So Ngidi comes back strongly! Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point. A good recovery in the end by the visitors! They have pulled it back well. Windies are 57 for 2 after the first 6.
The tennis ball bounce again causes problems! Shorter and on middle, Simmons looks to pull but is done in by the extra bounce.
A dot! A slower short ball outside off, Simmons does not pick it. He slashes late but misses.
FOUR! That is superb batting! He shows that he is going to make room but then shuffles in. Ngidi bowls a full toss on the pads, Simmons delicately plays it fine down to the fine leg fence.

SIX! Simmons is in the mood here! 50 up for the Windies and they have lost the two wickets but they are going at at a good rate. Fuller and outside off, Simmons makes room and lifts it over covers for a biggie.
Drop and run! On off, Hetmyer plays it towards cover for one. Good sensible batting! He gets Simmons back on strike!
FOUR! Carved away! A fuller delivery, outside off. Simmons carves it through cover-point for a boundary.
SWING AND A MISS! Another fuller ball, outside off. Simmons misses his drive.
Yorker, on middle. Simmons squeezes it out to the point fielder. He looks for the run, but sent back by Hetmyer, cleaverly.
SIX! Muscled over! A length ball, around middle and off. Simmons clears his front foot and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
This is very good bowling from Anrich Nortje. A slower fuller ball, just around off. Simmons looks to slash but misses it completely.
On middle, on a good length, clipped to square leg for one run.
On the pads. Flicked to square leg for another single. Just 3 runs and a wicket off this over.
A pacy short ball, on middle. Simmons looks to pull but gets a bottom edge, onto the pads, single taken as the ball lobs on the leg side.
Length ball, outside off. Hetmyer pushes it on the off side and takes a quick single. Off the mark straightaway.
Shimron Hetmyer is the new man in!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The Universe Boss departs just for 5 runs. Huge wicket for South Africa. Everyone knows how dangerous he can be! A fullish length delivery, outside off. Chris Gayle looks to drive but is too early on his stroke, gets a thick outside edge, straight in the mitts of Quinton de Kock, who takes a simple catch. Rabada gets him again.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Another dot! A length ball, outside off. Gayle dabs it but finds the fielder at short third man.
Fuller ball, angling around off. Gayle drives it straight to covers.
Rabada is on now!
TAP AND RUN! A length ball, outside off. Gayle defends it to covers and runs for a quick single.
BEATEN! A fuller delivery, slanting across, outside off. Gayle looks to drive but misses.
Another crisply driven but straight to covers.
On middle. Gayle nudges it to the leg side.
FOUR! Gayle is off the mark straightaway! Full ball, outside off. Gayle drives it through covers for four.
Chris Gayle walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! Anrich Nortje strikes early and gets the dangerous Evin Lewis! A fuller delivery, on middle. Lewis gets caught in two minds, to defend or to push. The ball even hit the deck and holds, hitting Lewis on the upper half of his blade, it lobs towards mid on where Aiden Markram dives to his right and takes a good catch. Welcome wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiden Markram b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely Bowled! A length delivery, on middle. Simmons blocks it out on the deck. Just 7 runs coming off this over.
SWING AND A MISS! A good length ball, outside off. Simmons looks for an expansive drive but misses.
Fuller delivery, way outside off. Lewis drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Low full toss, around middle. Lewis drives it but straight to mid on.
SIX! Banged! What a way to get off the mark! Fuller ball, in the arc, around middle and off. Lewis stands tall and muscles it over long on fence for a biggie.
A length ball, outside off. Lewis crisply drives it, but straight to covers.

SIX! 20 from the first over! Simmons is already in top gear! Flatter and quicker, outside off. Lendl Simmons stands tall and lofts it straight down the ground, over the bowler's head for a biggie. It was probably not a good idea to begin with Markram.
Outside off. Pushed to covers.
SIX! Already 14 off the first 4 balls! Another loopy ball, on middle. Simmons gets down on one knee and slogs it away over square leg for a six.
FOUR! Cracked away! Loopy ball, outside off. Simmons rocks back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out back to the bowler.
FOUR! Starts the proceedings with a boundary! Tossed up, on middle. Simmons shuffles across and slogs it over square leg for a boundary. West Indies and Lendl Simmons are underway.
Now then, the rain has passed away and we are now good to go! The sun is also out. Now the openers, Simmons and Lewis make their way out to the middle. Markram to open the bowling. Here we go...

The rain has cleared out and the players make their way out to the middle! We are not far away from the action. Just as we get ready for the game to begin! THE RAIN IS BACK AND THE COVERS ARE ON AGAIN!

PITCH REPORT - Haysman says there has been a lot of rain and the outfield should be slow. Mentions the wicket is nice and dry, it has been slowing down and the spinners will come into play. Mentions boundaries will be easy to hit with the new ball but it should get difficult as the game progresses.

Shimron Hetmyer says they need to understand the situation a little but first they need to enjoy themselves and play their normal game. Adds he feels this is one of the best batting wickets and they just need to finish the game nicely. Mentions it is about regrouping and doing well in the last last two games.

David Miller says defending such totals against Windies is a big confidence booster, they have powerful hitters but their bowlers have been brilliant. Adds it has been challenging to bat but he takes confidence from the team winning and he hopes he can do well here. States a win here will be a huge confidence booster and it will be a good confidence booster.
It has started to drizzle! It is not very heavy but the covers are on.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Evin Lewis, Lendl Simmons, Chris Gayle, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran(w), Kieron Pollard(c), Andre Russell, Fabian Allen, Dwayne Bravo, Obed McCoy, Fidel Edwards.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock(w), Reeza Hendricks, Temba Bavuma(c), Aiden Markram, Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, George Linde, Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi, Lungi Ngidi.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and ELECTED TO FIELD!

Time for round 4 of and which is also the second last game of this T20I series between the Windies and South Africa. A must-win for the hosts as a loss will see them losing the series. The visitors on the other hand, will hope they can emulate the performance of their last two games and seal the series with a game to go. All to play for. Stay tuned for the toss which could well be very important. The Windies have won three and elected to bowl, will we see a different strategy or will we see Bavuma win it this time? Stay tuned to find out...
